mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) has potential ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity; cenobamate requires renal monitoring and may accumulate with renal impairment, increasing seizure control variability and adverse effects.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly; assess hearing if prolonged concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration during amikacin therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
